nodes.label: Import wizard (Load data)
nodes.rationale: Three steps, nothing applied until the reader has seen what was read; file is read in the browser, held in memory, never uploaded.

nodes.label: Column mapping by synonym list
nodes.rationale: Headings matched against synonyms (Issue key/Key/Task ID/gid); every guess shown with an example and overridable. Only key, summary, status are required; everything else degrades with the preview naming which cards go blank.

nodes.label: Added-mid-sprint inferred from created date
nodes.rationale: Almost no tracker exports it; anything created after sprint start counts as added. Labelled as a proxy, but inferred rather than left blank because it drives the burndown scope line, the most useful thing over a stock Jira report.

nodes.label: All-numeric date disambiguation
nodes.rationale: Whole column scanned; a first part above 12 proves day-first. If nothing disambiguates it warns loudly rather than guessing, because a reversed format silently corrupts every elapsed-time figure.

nodes.label: Replace or merge apply modes
nodes.rationale: Merge updates matching keys and only overwrites fields the file supplied, which is how a key,businessValue,valueBasis file layers on top of a Jira export.

nodes.label: Burndown and history row recomputed on upload
nodes.rationale: Stale charts under fresh numbers is worse than no charts; only releases[] and dora{} carry forward because no tracker export contains them.

nodes.label: Started date lives in the changelog, not the export
nodes.rationale: A CSV cannot give when work started; without it there is no cycle time. Use a Development-started field or scripts/fetch_delivery_data.py which derives it from the changelog.
